name: hrisense
description: HSJ HRISense: An AI-Assisted Workforce Administration System with Compliance Decision for Hospicio de San Jose

scripts.dev: node scripts/preflight.js && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --restart-tries 3 --restart-after 1000 --names "WEB,API" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/web && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
